Present pacing follows the refresh rate of the screen the window is on (integer-fraction tier, ported from upstream d2r-mobile 44a6770): the game window was on a 30 Hz TV, where fixed-60 pacing shows each frame half a refresh and the system rounds to two → 33 ms frames, every frame counted dropped, perceived as flicker; front_mac.m reports the screen and re-reads on screen change
